refactor(camellia): align system preset surfaces

Summary:
- move system settings hub and system info cards onto shared preset-driven
  surfaces
- refactor server override and template detail pages to use shared Card
  composition instead of route-local shells
- keep existing page behavior and hidden-route loaders intact

Rationale:
- these routes were still carrying obvious page-local card treatments after
  the preset foundation landed
- moving them onto shared card semantics reduces the remaining visual drift
  before the final route-family passes

Tests:
- pnpm --dir bougainvillea run check:camellia
- PORT=3214 pnpm --dir bougainvillea --filter @bougainvillea/camellia start
- curl -I http://127.0.0.1:3214/system/settings
- curl -I http://127.0.0.1:3214/system/info
- curl -I http://127.0.0.1:3214/system/settings/server
- curl -I http://127.0.0.1:3214/template/manage/item/tpl-shelf-202
